alert_rule.ORANGE: HIGH forecast risk OR Priority_Rank <= 5, excluding RED

important_interpretation: Alert levels are research-defined operational planning indicators and are not official clinical or public-health warning standards.
horizon_handling: H1, H3 and H6 alerts are generated separately. Predictions from different forecast origins are not mixed to create one alert.
methodology_protection: Step 25 Triposha planning estimates retained unchanged
No 2025 actual malnutrition outcomes used for alert generation
No cross-horizon mixing for a single alert
